lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8Mg4Rh8 (reduced formula Nd2MgRh2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Mg and Rh each have eight Nd neighbors, while Nd has four Mg and four Rh neighbors, all at 3.009 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show Nd–Nd 8-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Mg–Rh pairs sharing corners and faces.
